name: Rumeen Farhana
role: Independent candidate and former BNP leader
contribution: She contested as an independent in the 2026 election and became one of the most visible non-major-party candidates in the contest.
context: Brahmanbaria-2 contest during Bangladesh's 2026 parliamentary election.
impact: Her campaign illustrated the space available to prominent independents outside the main party blocs.
highlight: A high-profile independent who broke from BNP politics.
